subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and maintain the experimental grouped-Claw manifest and read-only planning CLI in core, rather than keeping this package workflow in ClawHub/plugin-owned surfaces?
rationale: The patch is intentionally bounded and has no remaining demonstrated mechanical defect, but it introduces a new core product, environment, CLI, schema, and output contract that later stacked changes treat as their foundation.

options.title: Sponsor the read-only core slice
options.body: Approve this exact experimental, opt-in inspect and dry-run planning contract while requiring later mutation slices to remain separately reviewed.

options.title: Route packaging outside core
options.body: Decline the new core contract and ask for the grouped-agent package format to use the existing ClawHub/plugin seams instead.

options.title: Defer until the RFC settles
options.body: Hold this PR without merging until the RFC records the durable ownership, compatibility, and lifecycle commitments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the read-only core slice
recommendation.body: Approve this exact experimental, opt-in inspect and dry-run planning contract while requiring later mutation slices to remain separately reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: Omar supplied the clearest current design guidance on the intended host-neutral Claw boundary and the conditions for using it as a foundation.
